summary: Mesoblast, an Australian foreign private issuer listed on ASX and Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an ASX Appendix 3Z Final Director's Interest Notice and a press release dated November 1-2, 2026. The filing discloses planned board retirements: William Burns departs at the 2026 AGM after 12 years, with Jane Bell AM assuming sole chair of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Dr. Philip Krause, a director since 2022, ceased board service October 31, 2026, holding 28,750 ADSs and 3,385,000 options. These are scheduled rotational retirements, not an abrupt forced departure; the company reiterated intent to add commercially experienced directors. No terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks. Watch for subsequent appointments.
